name: outro-2-square
notes: Story panels between and after the rooms.

slots.subject: A town square with a stone fountain running with clear water, a tall lit lamp beside it, and a small group of children and grown-ups in old-fashioned clothes gathered around a scale on a table, pointing at it and talking. Warm late afternoon light.
slots.camera: High isometric view from above, parallel projection.
slots.composition: The fountain and the group around the scale in the centre.
